description:
The process starts with defining the objectives of a marketing campaign, including the target audience and goals such as generating leads or increasing brand awareness.
The marketing team creates the content, designs the visuals, and selects channels for promotion, whether digital ads, emails, or social media posts.
The campaign is launched, and its performance is tracked in real-time through various metrics like click-through rates and conversions.
Leads generated from the campaign are collected in the CRM system, where sales teams can follow up.
The process concludes when the campaign period ends, and performance is analyzed for future optimization.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Campaign" name="Campaign planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_DefineObjectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives, audience, and goals">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Objectives_PreparationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare campaign materials and channels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Objectives_PreparationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CreateContent</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_DesignVisuals</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SelectChannels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CreateContent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateContent_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design campaign visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_DesignVisuals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DesignVisuals_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SelectChannels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectChannels_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateContent_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DesignVisuals_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectChannels_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparationJoin_Launch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparationJoin_Launch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Launch_OperationsSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OperationsSplit" name="Track performance and handle leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Launch_OperationsSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OperationsSplit_Track</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OperationsSplit_CollectLeads</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OperationsSplit_Track</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Track_OperationsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in the CRM system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OperationsSplit_CollectLeads</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectLeads_SalesFollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SalesFollowUp" name="Sales teams follow up with leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectLeads_SalesFollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SalesFollowUp_OperationsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OperationsJoin" name="Campaign activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Track_OperationsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SalesFollowUp_OperationsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OperationsJoin_PeriodEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OperationsJoin_PeriodEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PeriodEnd_Analyze</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_CampaignPeriodEnd"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance for future optimization">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PeriodEnd_Analyze</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Campaign" name="Campaign performance analyzed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_DefineObjectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_Campaign" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Objectives_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CreateContent" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_DesignVisuals" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SelectChannels" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateContent_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignVisuals_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectChannels_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Launch" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Launch_OperationsSplit" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Gateway_OperationsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OperationsSplit_Track" sourceRef="Gateway_OperationsSplit" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OperationsSplit_CollectLeads" sourceRef="Gateway_OperationsSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Track_OperationsJoin" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_OperationsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectLeads_SalesFollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_SalesFollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SalesFollowUp_OperationsJoin" sourceRef="Task_SalesFollowUp" targetRef="Gateway_OperationsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OperationsJoin_PeriodEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_OperationsJoin" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEnd_Analyze" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_End" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_Campaign"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
